title: Subgraphs inherit 2-colourability
statement: Let $G$ and $H$ be simple graphs on a common finite vertex set, and suppose $H$ is a subgraph of $G$ (every edge of $H$ is an edge of $G$). If $G$ admits a proper vertex colouring with two colours, then so does $H$.
hypotheses_covered: H is a subgraph of G (H ≤ G)
replaced: \emph{Every subgraph of a bipartite graph is bipartite.}
